name: The dragons weigh the risk

date.label: Wrath of the Lich King, patch 3.3.5 quest sequence; exact in-world date unknown

summary: At Wyrmrest Temple, Krasus lends the seekers a record of the ancient blade. Kalecgos asks whether mortals should command such power: the dragons have known the grief of a mighty weapon turned against them. Alexstrasza permits the search to continue, though permission is not an answer to every fear. Beneath the red-bronze shrine, the hilt’s past begins to emerge as both a promise and a warning.
